title: SkillGuardVerdict
description: Verdict and evaluation report for governed skills, agents, commands, and hooks.

artifact_path.description: Relative POSIX path to the evaluated artifact.

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the artifact content at review time.

verdict.description: Formal governance verdict. ALLOW permits execution, REJECT permanently blocks, CONDITIONAL requires satisfies_conditions, and BOOTSTRAP is temporary unreviewed baseline.

report.description: Detailed evaluation report documenting permissions, blast radius, safety checks, and findings.

risk_score.description: Computed risk score from 0.0 (safest) to 100.0 (highest risk).

conditions.description: Mandatory runtime constraints or environmental conditions required if verdict is CONDITIONAL.

reviewed_by.description: Identifier of the reviewer agent or human authority.

reviewed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the review event.
